story: YouTube broke for 40% of the UK population after rolling out 60 FPS videos
text: Videos that are submitted in 60 FPS are only available in 60 FPS. It's getting more common as the cameras as getting cheaper. Check this for example, you should only have the choice between 60 FPS options. [VIDEO] Videos that were submitted in 30 FPS remain as they were. It doesn't make sense to create new frames out of nothing indeed.
